comment: Architecture: V3 Ch6 (Event Lineage / Causal Graph); V3 Ch7 (Replay). Call lineage documents capture the ordered event sequence for each call, enabling deterministic replay and forensic analysis. Each document corresponds to one call and embeds a chronological array of events with their correlation and causation IDs.

options.comment: Supports cross-call correlation queries (e.g. tracing a session across retried calls).
Sprint-014: TTL retention — 90 days per V4 Ch11.3 (added; missing since Sprint-002).
